text:
Hey, I had a very similar situation in January where my Israeli wife went for me to Misrad Hapnim in Yafo ten days after she gave birth. The time frame for me was even tighter, inviting my parents from Germany 10days after the appointment.

We never heard back from Misrad Hapnim on the application and my parents entered without problem. However in the middle of their stay their ETA was suddenly revoked and later investigation with the embassy in Germany showed that they are now under a one year travel ban.

We still do not know why exactly this happened but I believe it is due to the short time between invitation and arrival that just confused the clerk at Misrad Hapnim.
